body:
This reverts commit 06734eb87aa7898d0b35a91b44ce22b794a40255.

The reverted commit was a change to improve ttfx
in downstream ClimaLand. I recently realized that
[this](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/pull/1906) climaland PR gives the similar ttfx imrpovements to the diagnostics, while also improving other ttfx areas. When stacked on that PR, the ClimaDiagnostics change only gives a minimal ttfx improvement.
